column1: # WLTP electricity consumption of electric and plug-in hybrid cars registered in Finland 2020-2022,
# for models that are missing from the 2025 register extract (cars no longer sold new in 2025).
# Source: EEA, Monitoring of CO2 emissions from passenger cars (Regulation (EU) 2019/631), CC BY 4.0,
# read through the EEA Discodata service, table [CO2Emission].[latest].[co2cars], 17 Nov 2026:
# wh_km = median of the field "Z (Wh/km)" over rows with MS = 'FI', pooled by make + commercial name.
# years: 2021-2022 where the model was registered then, otherwise 2020. Earlier years are left out
# because their values were still partly measured with the older NEDC test and are not comparable.
# rows = register rows behind the median (provisional and final datasets both count, so this is
# roughly twice the number of cars). pt: E = battery electric, P = plug-in hybrid.
